name: zgeometry_weiler_divide_contour_segment_at_point
description: zGeometry_Weiler::DivideContourSegmentAtPoint splits a contour segment at a crossing point and relinks the inserted segment into the contour ring.
known_limits: Binary Ninja has documented HLIL limitations around the IsNearEqualXY callsite and one contour-link store. Assembly is the accepted behavior evidence.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry Weiler source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x468580 validates the IsNearEqualXY end-point fast path, segment-buffer append path, start/end point transfer, old-next relink, contour type copy, contourOutput reset, endXing copy, dirty flag writes, and optional split-link update.

The native clip leaf smoke verifies the append split path, inserted segment linkage, copied contour type/end crossing, null contour output, dirty flags, segment end rewrite, old-next back-link, and crossing back-references.
